match.reason: The closest bank point, ecb-productivity, defines productivity but does not link it to well-managed, motivated staff or to a business competing on cost, so it teaches a related idea rather than this one.

draft.title: Productivity and competitiveness
card: Productivity is how much a business produces for each hour of work. If staff make more in the same time, productivity rises.
Well-managed, motivated staff tend to be more productive. They waste less time and make fewer mistakes.
Higher productivity spreads the cost of wages over more output. The cost of making each item falls.
Lower costs let a business charge lower prices or earn more profit on each sale. This helps it compete with other businesses.
draft.remember: More output per hour means lower cost per item, which helps a business compete.

a.q: A factory pays the same wages, but its staff now make more shoes each hour. What happens to the cost of making each pair?
opts: It falls, as wages are spread over more pairs
It rises, as more shoes need more wages
It stays the same, as wages did not change
It rises, as staff are working faster
a.why: The same wages are shared across more pairs of shoes, so each pair costs less to make. Wages did not change, but output rose, so the cost per pair does not stay the same.
a.clue: Divide the same wages by more shoes.

b.q: Two cafés in Geelong pay staff the same hourly rate. Café A's motivated staff serve 30 customers an hour. Café B's staff serve 20. Which is the most likely result?
opts: Café A has a lower wage cost per customer
Café B has a lower wage cost per customer
Both have the same wage cost per customer
Café A has a higher wage cost per customer
b.why: The same hourly pay is spread over more customers at Café A, so its wage cost per customer is lower. Equal hourly pay does not mean equal cost per customer, because output per hour differs.
b.clue: Compare wage cost per customer, not pay per hour.

a.best: It falls, as wages are spread over more pairs

b.best: Café A has a lower wage cost per customer
